data.name: Chooose AS
data.description: Chooose AS is an Oslo-based climate-tech SaaS company founded in 2017 that provides software, APIs, and a marketplace platform for enterprises — particularly airlines, travel, and logistics firms — to manage SAF programs, calculate emissions, and access vetted carbon removals and offsets. They do not physically remove CO2; they operate as an ecosystem platform connecting buyers with SAF producers and carbon project developers. Customers include Delta, Air Canada, British Airways, Alaska Airlines, Japan Airlines, and Booking.com.
